summary.text: The blood pond graveyard is a forbidden ground that buried the first generation's coffin, known to only one or two clan elders.

claims.text: Gu Yue Bo, holding the clan’s secret history, knows that the first generation ancestor’s will told descendants to bring a Gu Master with the Ancient Moon Desolate Yin body into the blood pond graveyard. Gu Yue Bo had studied that will and found that the ancestor seemed to know a method to curb the ten extreme physiques’ weakness, kept in his coffin in the graveyard.

Fang Yuan is sucked from the spirit spring by a blood colored light and dragged down a tunnel. He falls about fifteen metres in an underground space filled with red light, toward a pond of blood water. He estimates this is deeper than the underground cave. In his previous life he was not strong enough to learn the secrets of the higher-ups, so he does not recognise the place. Even among clan elders, only one or two knew this secret.

The blood pond shines with a bloody radiance. Its circumference is even larger than the village, and it emits an eerie and scary aura. At the top of the cave, up to a hundred holes gush water, bringing shells, turtles, snakes, and fish from the river. In a few breaths the blood is sucked from those creatures. They turn into dry corpses and float on the surface. Other than fresh dry corpses there are bones in the water: fish bones, bear bones, and human skeletons. Ripples sweep into the surrounding walls, and bright red glowing blood water turns the soil into red soil.

A blood river python surfaces from the pond during Tie Xue Leng’s arrival. Fang Yuan recalls Gu Yue clan history: after the first generation clan leader created the village, a blood river python appeared as a huge threat, and legend says the first gen killed it.

A whirlpool spreads across the blood lake until its edges touch the walls. A giant blood wave gushes from the middle, and a vertical crimson coffin rises from within it. The lid shoots off and reveals a shrivelled corpse. Fang Yuan names rank five Blood Wight Gu and asks whether this is the first head. The first head had turned himself into a blood wight flying zombie and buried himself here.
